title: Frequency-Response Visualiser
summary: Explore how poles, zeros, gain, delay, sampling and a controller shape a feedback loop's frequency response, for single loops and multivariable (MIMO) loops in continuous or discrete time. Blocks can be discretised by zero-order hold, Tustin (with optional prewarp) or forward or backward Euler. Bode, singular-value, Nyquist and Nichols views and a pole-zero map give gain, phase and delay margins, sensitivity peaks and closed-loop poles against user-set thresholds, with a Nyquist count (det(I + L) for MIMO) cross-checked against the closed-loop eigenvalues and MIMO eigenvalue-locus, return-difference and loop-at-a-time margins at the plant input and output. Exports Markdown, JSON, CSV and SVG, imports its own JSON, checks itself against analytic cases on every load, and runs offline. Exploration only, not a verified control-design toolchain.
